subject.title: fix(doctor): flag missing plugin install paths

question: Should doctor --fix remove persisted plugin install records when the recorded primary install path is missing?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive persisted-state repair: it likely fixes stale package paths, but it can also forget a record if a path is temporarily unavailable at repair time.

options.title: Accept missing-path cleanup
options.body: Land the current repair after reviewing the final merge result, using the posted scratch CLI proof as sufficient upgrade-safety evidence.

options.title: Narrow the deletion rule
options.body: Require extra checks or tests for sourcePath/installPath combinations or temporarily unavailable paths before deleting records.

options.title: Pause for broader upgrade proof
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers see proof against a real upgraded home with stale official plugin records.

recommendation.title: Accept missing-path cleanup
recommendation.body: Land the current repair after reviewing the final merge result, using the posted scratch CLI proof as sufficient upgrade-safety evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently introduced and merged the current doctor plugin registry path that this PR extends.
